correctness.rationale: The unordered two-point cubical deleted-product cell model is valid for these sufficiently subdivided simple complete multipartite graphs. An equivariant projection to graph 1-chains, together with Ko–Park H1 dimension/torsion, gives H1 character E-F+1. Fixed zero/one/two cubes have exact signed traces, including negative orientation from two exchanged moving edges; Euler-Lefschetz gives the stated H2 character. Color-permutation invariant chains and the graph quotient K_k give rational Betti (1,C(k-1,2),3C(k,4)). Independent direct cell trace tests for (3,3,3),(3,3,4),(3,3,3,3) matched for 10,10,15 permutations respectively; all-family reasoning is analytical.
